# V1.5 — Beta Feedback Round 1

**Status:** Done. All slices (0, 1A, 1B, 2–9) committed on `main`, live-Supabase schema for slice 9 fully applied and device-verified. See [v1.5-post-ship-audit.md](v1.5-post-ship-audit.md) for the 11-item audit that followed shipping this version — all 11 items are now closed too.

14 feedbacks from unofficial (APK-shared) beta testers, grilled end-to-end on 2026-06-30. Docs written this grill: ADR-0023 (app-lock overlay + never-remove-PIN), ADR-0024 (onboarding gated on post-sync emptiness), ADR-0025 (shared savings goals via derived contribution ledger), ADR-0026 (docked center Add + 3-pin budget, amends ADR-0017). New `CONTEXT.md` glossary: Savings goal, Goal contribution, Saved amount, Budget period, Lock overlay, Onboarding, New-user gate. Grill docs commit: `7593d62`.

## The key finding (reframes everything)

Item 11 ("my half-written transaction vanishes when I background ~30s") is **not** a dialog problem and is **not** fixed by converting the add-txn modal to a screen. Root cause: the app lock was a **branch-swap** in `MainActivity` (`if (isLocked) LockScreen else IponApp`). The ~30s is the lock grace period. Locking tore the whole `NavHost` out of composition; unlock rebuilt the NavController + all nav-scoped ViewModels from the start destination — every in-progress draft, app-wide, was destroyed. Fix = render the lock as an **overlay** above an always-composed `IponApp` (+ `SavedStateHandle` for true process death). The modal→screen conversion (slice 1A) proceeds but is justified by UX only, not durability.

## Slices (build order: 0 → 1A/1B → 2 → 3 → 4–7 independent → 8, 9 last)

**Slice 0 — App-lock overlay + PIN stale-fill fix** · Opus, medium · items 11, 8 · ADR-0023 · `af32b94`
(a) `MainActivity`: `IponApp` is now **always composed** (no more branch-swap tearing out the NavHost) → drafts survive the lock. (b) `AppLockViewModel`: `pin` cleared on lock-engage and on successful verify.
Key discovery during device verify: the ADR's literal "Box overlay" was **insufficient and a security bug** — a Compose `AlertDialog`/`Dialog` (the still-dialog-based transaction editor at the time) is its own platform Window that always draws above the Activity's main-window content, so a same-window `Box` overlay left the draft (incl. sensitive amount) visible on top of the lock screen. Fix: render `LockScreen` itself inside a `Dialog(usePlatformDefaultWidth=false, dismissOnBackPress=false, dismissOnClickOutside=false)` — a Dialog window added after any open dialogs reliably stacks on top. Device-verified: draft intact across background→30s grace→resume→unlock; lock fully covers the editor dialog while locked; PIN pad empty on every re-lock.

**Slice 1A — Add-transaction full-screen route + grid picker** · Opus, medium · items 11, 5, 9 · `ae6fd9b`
(Renamed 1→1A when 1B was split out.) New `add_transaction`+`edit_transaction/{txnId}` routes; editor converted from `AlertDialog` → `AddTransactionScreen` (full Scaffold). Editor logic split: `TransactionEditorState`, pure `TransactionEditorReducer` (type-normalization, shared-account privacy clearing, `build()` → `Invalid`/`OwedInvalid`/`Ready`), `AddTransactionUiState`, `AddTransactionViewModel`. **Draft mirrored into `SavedStateHandle`** on every edit (~14 `draft_*` keys; cleared on save; hydration order = restored draft → DB load (edit) → fresh create). `canPayForPartner`/`partnerName` moved off the editor state onto derived UI state. Picker: tap-to-select, no dropdown — categories = wrapping icon+color grid (`CategoryGrid`/`CategoryTile`), type+accounts = `IponFilterChip` pill rows. Records tab stripped to a pure list — FAB + row-click navigate to the route. 10 new tests; 439 total.

**Slice 1B — Notes editor draft survival + system-back save** · Opus, medium · `2f12577`
Notes was already a full-screen route, so this was purely draft-survival. Design chose composable-owned draft over a full VM-flow rewrite: `NoteEditorScreen` holds `title`+`draftHtml` in `rememberSaveable` (survives both rotation and process death uniformly). `RichTextState` isn't saveable, so its HTML mirrors into `draftHtml` via `snapshotFlow { richTextState.toHtml() }`, re-seeded on every recomposition from `draftHtml ?: state.initialHtml` (guarded by a plain `remember` `contentSeeded`). VM changes were minimal: stable new-note id stashed in `SavedStateHandle` (fixes a latent pre-1B bug — a recreated VM would otherwise mint a new id and orphan already-saved attachments); new-note share intent mirrored too. Save model stayed auto-save-on-exit (Keep/Notes-style). System-back fix folded in: `BackHandler { saveAndExit() }` self-guards on `contentSeeded`. 441 tests (unchanged — pure UI/VM presentation, verified by running).

**Note-preview entity-decode fix** · `d8a626c`
Beta report: note-list preview showed raw `&comma;`/`&lpar;`/`&period;` etc. Root cause: `mohamedrejeb.richeditor`'s `toHtml()` escapes ordinary punctuation as HTML5 named entities, but `NoteContentText.plainText` only decoded 6 named entities + `&#39;`. Fix: generic numeric `&#N;`/hex `&#xN;` decoding + a full ASCII-punctuation/typographic named-entity map (`&amp;` applied last to avoid cascade). +3 tests (444 total).

**Slice 2 — Navbar: center ⊕ + MAX_PINS 3** · Opus, low-med · items 1, 2, 5 · ADR-0026 · `7c1b7e7` (ADR+glossary in `7593d62`)
`NavRegistry.MAX_PINS` 4→3. Center ⊕ = accented `NavigationBarItem` (not a cradle FAB) → `ADD_TRANSACTION_ROUTE`, rendered mid-bar via `splitIndex = ((visiblePins.size + 2) / 2).coerceAtMost(size)`. `DEFAULT_PINS` reordered to `[ANALYSIS, RECORDS, COUPLE]`. `SETTINGS` made `pinnable=true`. `COUPLE` → `requiresPaired=true` with `understudyId = MANAGE.id`: instead of the bar collapsing when unpaired, Couple's slot is filled by Manage. `NavResolver.visiblePinIds` rewritten to promote the understudy in place unless already pinned/visible. Purely a bar-render concept — the saved `NavConfig` stays untouched so re-pairing restores Couple. 441 tests. **Note:** the `understudyId` mechanism and the `+2)/2` split formula were both later replaced — see [v1.5-post-ship-audit.md](v1.5-post-ship-audit.md) F7/F8, and slice 3/9's fixed-3-pin redesign (`b2c250e`).

**Slice 3 — Onboarding graph + new-user gate + unpaired pairing card** · Opus, high · items 6, 3 · ADR-0024 · `67d92ce`
First-run concept (none existed before). Flow: Welcome → pair-or-solo (explicit fork: *Invite my partner* / *I have a code* / *Solo*) → starter-template picker → Analysis home. Pairing before templates. Gate = `initialSyncDone && syncSucceeded && ownedCategories==0 && ownedAccounts==0 && !onboardingDone` — must be **post-successful-sync emptiness**, not local emptiness (else reinstall/2nd-device users get duplicate-seeded categories). No prompt on failed/offline first sync. `SeedStarterDataUseCase` (idempotent, personal rows `pending_sync=true`, FK order). Pairing/unpair relocated Couple-Overview → Settings → Couple; Couple module becomes paired-only. Dismissible pairing card on Analysis home for unpaired users. PH starter bundles: Everyday spending / Bills & utilities / Income / Accounts, pre-checked à-la-carte, skippable.

**Slice 8 — Biometric-primary lock + setup nudge** · Opus, medium · items 14, 13 · ADR-0023 · `cdbf748`
`LockScreen`: `showPinPad` (`rememberSaveable`, defaults `!isBiometricEnabled`); biometric mode auto-fires the prompt once and shows a persistent "Use PIN instead" button. All `BiometricPrompt` error codes (incl. lockout) fall back to the PIN pad; PIN pad is never removed, only visually deferred. New `AppLockPreferences.biometricNudgeShown` + `BiometricAvailability` (wraps `BiometricManager.canAuthenticate`). `AppLockSetupScreen`: on `pinSetSuccess`, if biometric ready+off+nudge-not-shown → dialog offering Enable/Not now. +3 tests (487 total).

**Slice 9 — Shared savings goals** · Opus, high · item 7 ("Wishlist" renamed) · ADR-0025 · `be7b8a6` (bundled with the unpair-bell fix, last V1.5 slice)
New `feature/savings/`. Two synced entities: `SavingsGoalEntity` (creator-owned metadata) + append-only `GoalContributionEntity` (goalId, userId=contributor, amount, note?, date). `savedAmount` is **derived** via pure `SavingsGoalCalculator` (Σ non-deleted contributions, both authors) — never stored (ADR-0007 pattern). Room v17→v18 (+2 entities, `@AutoMigration`). 4 syncers (`SavingsGoal`/`GoalContribution` plain LWW, `PartnerSavingsGoal`/`PartnerGoalContribution` via `BasePartnerTableSyncer`). Repos: `SavingsGoalRepositoryImpl` (creator-only writes, unshare retains `coupleId`) + `GoalContributionRepositoryImpl` (**random UUID per add = LWW-safety crux** — own vs. partner contributions are disjoint sets, distinct UUIDs, summed once each). `unpair()` amended to revert shared goals like notes. Presentation: `SavingsGoalsScreen` (list, reached 🎉, shared badge, archived toggle), `GoalEditorScreen`, `GoalDetailScreen` (ledger with You-vs-partner attribution). Grilled 10 sync/sharing decisions before building (see ADR-0025). 36 new tests (523 total). **Applied to live Supabase (staging) 2026-07-03**, tested end-to-end — see the reconciliation saga note below.

### Standalone fix bundled in `be7b8a6`: unpair() live-sync bell

Beta/dev testing found that after Device B unpairs, Device A needed a manual pull-to-refresh to see it — every other change propagates live within ~1-2s via the ADR-0015 bell, unpair silently didn't. Root cause: `CoupleRepositoryImpl.unpair()` called the RPC via a plain `syncEngine.sync()`, never through the `SyncTrigger → pushOnly → bell.broadcast()` path. A client-side ping couldn't fix it either way (broadcasting after the RPC is RLS-blocked once `auth_couple_id()` goes null; broadcasting before races the mutation). **Fix:** `unpair()` itself (the Postgres function) now calls `realtime.send(...)` inside its own transaction — `security definer` owned by `postgres` gets `BYPASSRLS`, Realtime only fans out post-commit, so no race and no Android change needed. Migration `2026-07-03_unpair_broadcast_bell.sql`, applied live, confirmed working.

### The unpair() reconciliation saga (2026-07-03) — read before touching `unpair()`

`unpair()` is `create or replace function`, so whichever definition ran **last** on live Supabase wins. Actual apply order: (1) the ad-hoc slice-9 migration — savings-goal revert, no bell (pre-bell snapshot). (2) `2026-07-03_unpair_broadcast_bell.sql` — bell fix, but its `unpair()` body **deliberately omitted** the savings-goal revert (scoped out because `savings_goals` wasn't live yet when it was written). Because (2) ran after (1) and `create or replace` fully replaces the body, live `unpair()` ended up with the bell but **missing** the savings-goal revert — a silent regression (not a leak, RLS still gated it, but stale `is_shared`/`couple_id` state). (3) Fix: the reconciled `unpair()` (both blocks present, identical to `schema.sql`) was applied and verified end-to-end. Saved as `supabase/migrations/2026-07-03_unpair_reconcile.sql`, `5c26292`.
**Lesson:** any migration doing `create or replace function unpair()` must paste the **current complete** body from `supabase/schema.sql` — the whole function is replaced, not merged.

Slice 0 first (unblocks the real item-11 fix; 1A's durability depends on the overlay existing). Then 1A, 2 (2's center ⊕ needs 1A's route). 3 next (highest user value). 4–7 independent. 8 + 9 last (9 = biggest, new entity).
